description_en: Refreshes file content on nodes. Supports refreshing by file, directory, cache tag, ignored parameters, hostname, and entire site
description_zh: 刷新节点上的文件内容。支持文件、目录、缓存标记、去参数、主机名及全站刷新
name: PurgeCaches

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the refresh node. Valid values:
file (default): file refresh.
cachekey: cache key refresh.
cachetag: cache label refresh.
directory: folder refresh.
ignoreParams: parameter-ignored refresh. This refers to removing the question mark (?) and all parameters after it from the request URL. When you commit a parameter-stripped URL through this API operation, the committed URL is matched against cached resource URLs after their parameters are stripped. If a cached resource URL matches the committed URL after parameter stripping, the point of presence executes the refresh on the cached resource.
hostname: hostname refresh.
purgeall: refreshes all cached content under the site
parameters.help_zh:
刷新任务类型，取值：
file（默认值）：文件刷新。
cachekey：cachekey刷新。
cachetag：缓存标签刷新。
directory：目录刷新。
ignoreParams：去参数刷新。去参数指的是去除请求URL中?及?之后的参数，去参数刷新指的是用户先通过接口提交去参数后的URL，然后用户提交的待刷新URL将会与已缓存资源的URL进行去参数匹配，如果已缓存资源的URL去参数以后与待刷新URL匹配，那么CDN节点将对缓存资源执行刷新处理。
hostname：主机名刷新。
purgeall：刷新站点下所有缓存
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en:
The header information corresponding to the cache key specified during the refresh. When the custom cache key feature is enabled, the cache key is generated based on the specified headers for the refresh.

UserGeo: country/region

Country/region codes follow the ISO 3166-2 standard.

UserDeviceType: device type. Valid values:

desktop

tablet

mobile

UserLanguage: language

Language codes follow the ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 standard. For example, set this to zh to refresh content in Chinese
fields.help_zh:
刷新时指定cachekey对应的头部信息，当对应自定义cachekey功能开关开启时，将根据指定头部生成cachekey进行刷新。

UserGeo：国家/地区

国家/地区代码遵循 ISO 3166-2 标准。

UserDeviceType：设备类型，目前有如下三个枚举值

desktop

tablet

mobile

UserLanguage：语言

语言代码遵循 ISO 639-1 标准或者 BCP47 标准，例如：输入zh，表示对语言为中文的内容进行刷新
fields.name: headers

fields.help_en: The list of cache keys to refresh. This parameter is required when Type is set to cachekey
fields.help_zh: cachekey刷新列表，类型为cachekey时需要指定
fields.name: cache_keys

fields.help_en: The list of cache tags to refresh. This parameter is required when Type is set to cachetag
fields.help_zh: 缓存标记刷新列表，类型为cachetag时需要指定
fields.name: cache_tags

fields.help_en: The list of directories to refresh. This parameter is required when Type is set to directory
fields.help_zh: 目录刷新列表，类型为directory时需要指定
fields.name: directories

fields.help_en: The list of files to refresh. This parameter is required when Type is set to file
fields.help_zh: 文件刷新列表，类型为file时需要指定
fields.name: files

fields.help_en: The list of hostnames to refresh. This parameter is required when Type is set to hostname
fields.help_zh: 主机名刷新列表，类型为hostname时需要指定
fields.name: hostnames

fields.help_en: The list of files with parameters ignored. This parameter is required when Type is set to ignoreParams
fields.help_zh: 忽略掉参数的文件列表，当类型为ignoreParams时需要指定
fields.name: ignore_params

fields.help_en: The entire site refresh flag. Default value: false. Set this parameter to true when Type is set to purgeall
fields.help_zh: 全站刷新标记。默认为false，当类型为purgeall时指定为true
fields.name: purge_all

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to refresh resources under the corresponding directory when the back-to-origin content is inconsistent with the origin server resources. Default value: false.
true: Refreshes all resources under the corresponding directory.
false: Refreshes only the changed resources under the corresponding directory.


This parameter applies to directory refresh, cache tag refresh, parameter-ignored refresh, hostname refresh, and entire site cache refresh
parameters.help_zh:
当回源内容和源站资源对比后不一致时，是否刷新对应目录下的资源。默认为false。
true：刷新对应目录下的全部资源。
false：刷新对应目录下发生变更的资源。


生效范围：目录刷新、缓存标签刷新、去参数刷新、主机名刷新及刷新站点下所有缓存
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to refresh edge computing cached resources. For example, this allows refreshing content cached by the Edge Routine CacheAPI API operation using edge functions
parameters.help_zh: 用于边缘计算缓存资源的刷新，例如允许对使用边缘函数CacheAPI接口缓存的内容进行刷新
parameters.name: edge_compute_purge

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. This ID is returned when you create a refresh or prefetch task
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，当您创建刷新或预热任务，会返回任务ID
